[h1][b]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/b][/h1][p]
We’re back on the road with another exciting post for Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths! This time, we’re focusing on polishing the experience and adding some cool new features to keep your engines – and your brains – running. From reworked minigames to graphics upgrades, here’s what’s new in the garage:[/p][p][/p]
[previewyoutube="2WU7JHkscv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]
[b] Reworked Minigames [/b]
We’ve given our minigames a fresh coat of paint! Not only do they look better, but they also come with more engaging mechanics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/a6052944ad54b091827a69f7079dca287aaa152e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]
[b] Reputation missions [/b]
Whether you’re fixing road signs, reviving broken generators, or completing new cargo missions – these aren’t just fun diversions. They’re now tightly tied into the reputation system! That’s right – by completing these interactive challenges, you’ll earn valuable reputation points, helping you unlock new missions and progress further into the world. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/084408164849bf4784d42ba6eb8878aec561a487.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]
[b] Updated Map System [/b]
Getting lost in the wilderness is half the fun… until you're trying to find that one side quest or hidden skill book. That’s why we’ve improved the map functionality. You can now easily track tasks related to reputation, and collectibles. Whether you're hunting down that elusive skill book or just trying to boost your rep, the new map UI will guide your way.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/9d553afb65dac0072ec517afd7eaffdc45eed2f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]

Full support for RTX features, DLSS, and even DLSS Frame Generation are in the game for those of you sporting the latest Nvidia GPUs. Expect better performance, cool lighting, and smoother frame rates. But that's not all — we’ve taken the time to painstakingly refine our maps and world design, ensuring every environment feels lived-in, scenic, and worth exploring. From sweeping mountain vistas to gritty back road details, the world of Dangerous Paths has never looked better. We honestly can’t wait for you to get behind the wheel and see it for yourself.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary 97
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since we last got in touch, but now we're back with a massive update for Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths, and trust us – it's been worth the wait! We've packed in a ton of new features, interactions, and systems to keep you busy on the perilous roads... Let's dive right in!

[previewyoutube=phI9LPvF1gY;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]New Interactions[/b]

We've significantly expanded the range of uses and interactions for your tools. You can now open and repair gates and signs, or even demolish blockades using your trusty machete. You can also pick up new objects such as cash, skill books that grant free skill unlocks, and customization items. Additionally, the bolt cutters are now useful for slicing through certain fences, while the winch can be used to break down terrain obstacles. And that's not all – keep an eye out for paint buckets scattered around in-game locales to alter your truck's color scheme and give it a fresh new look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ce1dd50ad883d88f2b69907d44f0e6fb25c62c6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] New Reputation System [/b]

With so many new interactions, we've also revamped the reputation system. To progress through certain missions, you'll now need to attain specific reputation levels. And how do you do that? By completing side quests, cargo deliveries, and smaller tasks that earn you reputation points. It's time to step up and prove your worth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/f110099cf8d0fd40e42dd3f3fc50a4135fc3a15d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] Skill System [/b]

Finally, the long-awaited skill system is here! We've introduced 4 distinct skill categories: Driving, Mechanics, Exploration, and Economy. Each skill can be purchased with the cash you've collected or, as mentioned earlier, by finding special skill books hidden throughout the world. Unlock them to gain a strategic edge and further tailor your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/16d9af3a8504fe235c5804270d98d353c9cdbf0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]

In addition to these major inclusions, we've revised the tutorial system to make it clearer and more informative, ensuring that every newcomer knows the ropes. We've also introduced a guidebook where you can revisit essential mechanics or view gameplay tips at any time. Not to mention, the game now has full controller support, updated UI, and numerous other quality-of-life improvements to make your journey smoother than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/26dc916097af06ce7d277c4191faa68e5dbc4ae1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/5d6362c1cbd78392fa405b5a32687a30f5984fc8.png[/img][/url]

Happy wrenching!

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Dev Diary #84 is up!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Truck Mechanics![/h1] 


After a long break, we are back to systematically publishing more developer posts containing information on the state of progress of the game. A lot has changed over that time :) Our team was constantly working on fine-tuning all the mechanics, maps, interface and economy. Practically every aspect has been improved in some degree. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/dcce63f5d5f7d9b954b87db7a5e21069b27550a2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b]Natural environment[/b][/h2]
The maps have undergone quite a metamorphosis. We have put a lot of work in expanding the environment and visual beautification. We focused on improving lighting, better vegetation coverage and added even more detail that will make the visual perception much better. The visual enhancement of the maps will make them more interesting to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/d1fa8a018657edd8a450c3fa9a872070f2da8032.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

When preparing the maps, we also tried to think about people who like exploration. We have prepared quite a lot of interesting places where it will be worthwhile to look and scout the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/e1e10d2f4c923eb22c288ecf6d854be45f196c2f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dangerous Paths [/b][/h2]
We also focused strongly on the aspect of improving the layout of roads on all maps. Virtually every point on the map is reached by multiple roads, some shorter and bumpier, others longer and definitely safer for your truck. Only your gameplay style will determine which one you choose. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/aeea319acd1ac54f369eb795223423a39e5aa52d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

Admittedly, today we won't be focusing so much on improvements to the UI, but we want to let you know that there are some, in order to make the game less difficult to understand and definitely easier to play. We will elaborate further on this in future posts.

[h1]Hello Truck Mechanics![/h1]

We're thrilled to tell you about the exciting side missions and unique features coming to Truck Mechanic Dangerous Paths. As you explore the vast world, you'll encounter various side missions that will put your skills as a truck mechanic to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/760a0fcf1deba36dcfcc2098ec2012f184cf505a.png[/img]

Repairing the mighty ZIL truck will be one of your primary tasks. That rugged vehicle will suffer wear and tear as you tackle challenging terrains and face unexpected obstacles. Each repair will present a new challenge, requiring you to diagnose the issues and fix them using your mechanical expertise. Whether it's repairing the engine, replacing damaged parts, or fixing the suspension, you'll have to ensure the truck is in top shape to conquer the dangerous paths ahead.

But that's not all. We're introducing a unique CB radio system that will enhance your gameplay experience. With the CB radio, you'll be able to communicate with other characters and receive additional side missions. You'll have the opportunity to get out of the real trouble and call for help. The CB radio will become an essential tool for staying connected and uncovering hidden opportunities within the game world.

[previewyoutube=iMSU6lFJIvU;full][/previewyoutube]
Each side mission will offer its own set of challenges and rewards. Some missions will test your driving skills as you navigate through tight spaces, while others will require you to find and retrieve specific items. Completing these missions successfully will earn you valuable rewards such as experience points, in-game currency, and unique truck upgrades.

We've put a lot of effort into designing diverse and engaging side missions that will keep you entertained throughout your journey. These missions will not only provide a break from the main story, but also offer a chance to explore different aspects of the game world and showcase your truck mechanic prowess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/0d7907977dfbc2c52ff59f68ba7d36abbe3f129c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/9bbc15484aefe557ba5815d81b19b249bd1637dc.jpg[/img]

[h2]CB will have more options - cool, huh?[/h2]
CB radio will be quite an important tool for you.  It will allow you to call for emergency assistance, order missing parts or have the ability to report an obstacles on the road. Interestingly, CB will not always work. Transmitting stations in the middle of the jungle are not maintained too often and are susceptible to various damages. It may turn out that in one part of the map it will work and in the next there will be no signal. That's not all! We are preparing a few more surprises, which we will tell you about soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/84e62fb6a096a03a94efdd1fe64c5b7bc4f49128.jpg[/img]

You will have the opportunity to ride by a huge plantation, a big mine, dense jungle, treacherous swamps. All maps will be stuffed with additional activities, hidden places, interesting side quests and more. Unlike in the prologue, the truck won't break down every now and then, there will be fewer scripted events and it will be your driving that will have the ultimate impact on breakdowns.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40733077/c2eaa57a86d227318da9502c0bf88521fdf1fa96.png[/img]

[h1]The Prologue is here, Mechanics! 🔥🧑‍🔧[/h1]

After many months of hard work, the day has finally come - [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue[/b] is now available for you to play ːsteamhappyː

[b]What is a FREE prologue?[/b]
Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue is a glimpse into the universe of an upcoming simulation game, showcasing the basic mechanics and a story introduction to the full game. 

[previewyoutube=jWu2IBT0tt0;full][/previewyoutube]

We are extremely happy that we delivered the prologue on time. Thanks for all the suggestions and tons of solid feedback from playtests. Remember you are taking an active part in the production. So please share some more ideas, more juicy feedback and suggestions for change - we're open. We feel like dropping everything and playing a bit more of our work, but unfortunately the full version will not make itself.

And this means only one thing - that the game will be changed and in the end it will be much.

[h2]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue Features:[/h2]

[b]Interesting storyline[/b]
– When creating Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue, our goal was not only to develop a solid gameplay with interesting game mechanics, but also an engaging story. Therefore, in addition to tinkering with the truck, you will learn what dangers you may encounter in the wilderness.

[b]Perform minor truck repairs on the road[/b]
– Imagine a situation where your car has broken down. Normally you call for roadside assistance and the problem is solved. But what if your truck broke down in the middle of nowhere? We give you the chance to test yourself in such a scenario. With a well-equipped toolbox you should be able to deal with all obstacles. Whether it's a flat tire or a broken engine.

[b]Garage serving as a hub for personalization [/b]
– The garage is a place where you will have the ability to customize the look of your truck to your own preference. Steering wheels, seats, gear knobs, and rims are just waiting to be pimped. The more tasks you complete, the more cash you will have for these sweet upgrades! Ride with swag!

[b]Side missions not only concerning the truck[/b]
– In addition to performing complex truck repairs, there will be those unrelated to the truck. All this is to encourage you to explore, and to show you that the whole world doesn't circle around your vehicle after all. As an experienced mechanic, you will have to step out of your comfort zone and try something new.

[b]Possibility to drive on the most difficult routes in the world[/b]
– The South American wilderness can be a real pain. Even for the most experienced drivers, so be ready for any scenario. Make thoughtful decisions and remember - there are many paths to your destination.

[b]The prologue is FREE! We wish you a wide road and successful repairs :)[/b]
